compact_wire.budget_meaning: Body-only logical work includes eight callback captures, three prefix lookups and all represented discriminator rows; not RSS, allocations or timings.

compact_writer.observed: One prefix/body/suffix lifecycle per column granule; first statistics PREFIX, later PREFIX_EMPTY. Physical stream switching, marks and aggregate checksums are separate writer concerns.

variant.observed: Zero rows emit no frame while visiting arms. Positive calls emit one row-count VarUInt plus ROW_TAGS or UNIFORM frame. NULL contributes no arm occurrence.

reused_validator.observed: inspect_frame bounds the exact frame in a larger borrowed tape; tag_at repeats uniform tags without a materialized tag vector. The selected decoder already uses this validator.

laws: Inspect one exact COMPACT discriminator frame and require its represented row count to equal the mark row count before arm counting.
NULL 255 never indexes an arm; uniform NULL and ordinary uniform tags still charge every represented row.
Every scheduled zero-count arm callback remains present; following MAP sizes/paths/values retain exact source extents.
Unknown outer modes and inner formats, zero/mismatched frame rows and out-of-roster non-NULL tags are CorruptPartError.
EOF-first preparation validates all marks and transport before publishing prepared metadata; failure leaves no prepared context.
No general arbitrary-MRK3-deletion detection claim: a mutation that forms another valid tape is not promised detectable.
Value codecs, existing request-budget/cache lifetime, quiescent-part and failed-operation-discard laws remain unchanged.

attacks: Unknown outer mode 2 and inner format 2 with transport-valid mutation
Frame row count 0, 1 or 3 for a two-row mark
Tag 254 in both mixed row-tag and uniform String frames
Later all-NULL mark 1 changed from 255 to 254 before prepared publication
